decisive_metrics.name: Data-centre revenue
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: Three quarters of the revenue and all of the growth. The thesis is this line and nothing else.

decisive_metrics.name: Revenue against last year
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: Whether the growth rate that earned the rating is still there.

gap.reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - the filer reports no margin by product line
gap.weakened_test: whether the mix shift improves profit, and not only revenue, cannot be tested

decisive_metrics.name: Gross margin by product line
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: Whether the data-centre mix lifts the blended margin, or merely the revenue.

what_is_changing.statement: INVENTED FIXTURE - Revenue grew from 3600 to 4200 million dollars and the data-centre line is now most of it. The rest of the business is flat, so the whole growth rate is one product line's growth rate.

ACHP.what_it_does: INVENTED FIXTURE - Alpha Chips designs the accelerator chips that data centres buy to train models, and sells them to cloud operators and large enterprises. A customer that lost Alpha would have to rewrite the software libraries it has already built against Alpha's chips before a rival's part could do the same work.

decisive_metrics.name: Order backlog
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: The revenue that has been ordered and not yet shipped. It is the only figure that separates a delay from a lost customer.

decisive_metrics.name: Revenue against last year
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: The fall the market is reacting to, read beside the backlog that explains it.

gap.reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - only the pair's combined cash flow was captured, not this company's own
gap.weakened_test: the cash test can be answered for the pair but not for this name on its own

decisive_metrics.name: Free cash flow
decisive_metrics.why_it_decides: Whether the deferred shipments are being funded out of cash or out of the balance sheet.

how_it_earns.line: INVENTED FIXTURE - Switchgear and control software, the whole of the business

what_is_changing.statement: INVENTED FIXTURE - Revenue fell from 2300 to 2100 million dollars because utilities delayed orders through a rate case, while the order backlog rose to 9800 million dollars. The shipments are deferred, not lost, and the backlog is the figure that says so.

BGRD.what_it_does: INVENTED FIXTURE - Beta Grid builds the switchgear and control software that electricity utilities install between a generator and the grid. A utility that lost Beta would have to re-certify a rival's switchgear with its regulator before it could connect anything new, which takes two to three years.

gaps.reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - no listed company earns a comparable share of its revenue the same way, so a peer multiple would compare two different businesses
gaps.weakened_test: the rating can be read only against the subject's own history, never against a peer set

gaps.reason: INVENTED FIXTURE - neither named company publishes quarterly guidance, so there is no guided figure to set beside a delivered one
gaps.weakened_test: whether management hits its own numbers cannot be tested; the delivery record is read from the backlog alone

question_verbatim: Is the AI infrastructure pair - Alpha Chips with Beta Grid - worth buying as one idea at today's prices? (INVENTED FIXTURE)

tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Alpha Chips bought back 1200 million dollars of shares over three years, paid no dividend, made no acquisition, and grew the diluted share count by 1.8 percent.

tier2.source: INVENTED FIXTURE - Alpha Chips Inc FY2026 annual report and trade-body data
tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Two designers supply almost all data-centre accelerators of this class: Alpha Chips at 61 percent of units and one unlisted rival at 33 percent. Alpha wins on the software libraries its customers have already written against. A customer who buys nothing keeps running its existing racks and pays about 3 times the power bill per unit of work.

tier2.source: INVENTED FIXTURE - Beta Grid Corp FY2024-FY2026 annual reports
tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Beta Grid paid 210 million dollars of dividends over three years, bought back nothing, acquired one transformer maker for 480 million dollars, and issued shares worth 4.6 percent of the count to fund it.

tier2.source: INVENTED FIXTURE - Beta Grid Corp FY2026 annual report and trade-body data
tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Grid switchgear of this rating is a fragmented market: Beta Grid holds 14 percent and no supplier holds more than 18 percent. Beta wins where the utility wants one supplier for both the switchgear and the control software. A utility that buys nothing runs its existing units past their 40 year design life and pays rising maintenance.
